name: Disable Inventory Collector
description: Stops Windows from gathering system inventory data for telemetry purposes.
commands:
reg add "HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\InventoryCollector" /v DisableInventoryCollector /t REG_DWORD /d 1 /f
reg add "HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\InventoryCollector" /v Start /t REG_DWORD /d 4 /f
revert22H2:
reg add "HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\InventoryCollector" /v DisableInventoryCollector /t REG_DWORD /d 0 /f
 sc config InventoryCollector start= auto
 sc start InventoryCollector
